info.title: Pleos Reservation Assistant — local MOCK API
info.description: Local MOCK API with server-issued opaque Bearer tokens and ownership isolation. Apps obtain an anonymous installation identity without login. GET /status and POST anonymous-sessions issuance/refresh are public; other operations require an access token. Token issuance does not grant MOCK_OPERATOR. No external calls; LIVE is disabled. URL remains /api/v1 by the pre-release BE-02 decision. Additive search-reconciliation operation is documented here; the core 1.1.0 compatibility marker remains unchanged for existing clients.

429.description: Issuance limited: 10 per direct peer and 100 total per minute on a single server

post.description: Create a new installation identity. Call only when no saved credentials exist. Never automatically replace an existing subject after a 401. No client-specified subject or role.

409.description: Refresh already used or retry unavailable

post.description: Rotate both tokens while preserving subject. Persist a random Idempotency-Key before sending. Same old refresh token and same key replay the same pair for 120 seconds, until the successor refresh is used or session revoked. Other replays return 409. Old access tokens remain valid until original expiry; revoke invalidates all generations. Send no expired Authorization header to this endpoint.

401.description: Missing, expired, or revoked access token

delete.description: Revoke this installation authentication session and every token generation. Does not delete owned records or create a replacement identity.

200.description: Durable reconciliation snapshot. COMPLETED is not a fresh search or reservation. REJECTED_CLOSED permits a separate explicit new search with a new key and fresh navigation; preserve tripId.

409.description: KEY_REUSED or REQUEST_NOT_CLOSABLE; keep original pending request unresolved.

post.description: Explicit recovery only: send the ORIGINAL search body and ORIGINAL Idempotency-Key with the same installation identity. Never executes search. Atomically returns COMPLETED and searchId for an existing matching command, or durably REJECTED_CLOSED for unprocessed past ETA / stale observation. A current or future-invalid request returns 409 REQUEST_NOT_CLOSABLE without closing it. Different body is KEY_REUSED. Retry exact inputs after lost response; never silently change key/time/identity.

Navigation.description: eta is an absolute RFC3339 instant, at most 24 hours ahead. observedAt must be within 5 minutes. PLEOS is reserved but rejected until ETA time-base verification; never guess a conversion from raw SDK integers. Reuse tripId for the same journey.

ChangePolicy.description: When enabled, latestTime must be non-null and at or after requestedTime. Budget is cumulative over accepted changes; learning consent grants no booking permission.

InquiryFacts.description: Missing/null means no new information. reservationAvailable and arrivalWaitMinutes require arrivalAppliesAt exactly equal to search ETA. NOW values never imply ARRIVAL values.

OutcomeRequest.description: Mock injection only, not a provider webhook. observedAt is preserved and must not precede the task. Booking/change confirms only on ACCEPTED + explicitAcceptance + exact time + exact cost. Completed/ANSWERED is UNKNOWN. Terminal outcomes cannot be overwritten.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Stable per user command. Reuse after timeout; changed body with same key returns 409. Event IDs independently deduplicate outcomes globally.

BearerAuth.description: Server-issued pa_ token. Refresh tokens cannot authorize resource requests.
